about_the_role: QuantEdge helps retail clients understand customer behaviour. The job is as much about asking the right question and communicating the answer as it is about modelling.
responsibilities: Explore large datasets to identify patterns, anomalies and business opportunities.
Build predictive models and validate them honestly with appropriate holdout strategies.
Design and analyse A/B tests, including sample size and significance calculations.
Create clear visualisations and dashboards that non-technical stakeholders can act on.
Write reproducible analysis code and document assumptions and limitations.
Present findings to business stakeholders and defend the methodology.
required_skills: Strong Python for data analysis, particularly Pandas and NumPy.
Advanced SQL including joins, window functions and aggregation over large tables.
Solid Statistics including distributions, confidence intervals and hypothesis testing.
Machine Learning experience with regression, classification and clustering methods.
Data Visualization skills using matplotlib, seaborn or an equivalent library.
Exploratory Data Analysis discipline and the ability to spot data quality problems.
preferred_skills: Experience with scikit-learn pipelines and hyperparameter tuning.
A/B Testing and experimentation design in a product setting.
Feature Engineering for tabular and time-series data.
Experience with Apache Spark or other distributed data processing.
Dashboarding with Tableau or Power BI.
Familiarity with R for statistical work.
Exposure to Deep Learning where it is genuinely warranted.
qualifications: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science or Economics.
A portfolio of analyses on real, messy datasets.
Ability to explain a model's limitations as clearly as its accuracy.
